column1: # Session state-machine transition cases, shared by the Windows and Android test suites.
# One case per line, tab-separated. Each test suite reads this file and runs every case against
# its own state machine; neither keeps a copy. See README.md beside this file.
# id            a stable name for the case
# given         events applied first, comma-separated, every one of which must be accepted; '-' for none
# accepted      yes if the state machine must accept it, no if it must reject it and leave the state as it was
# has_streamed  yes or no: whether this session has reached Streaming; '-' where the phase has no such notion
# attempt_fault kept if the fault of the last failed attempt is held in the state, none if not; '-' as above
# note          what the case is for

column8: note
A start is accepted from Disconnected
The transport connecting begins negotiation
Negotiation completing begins streaming
Losing a streaming connection begins reconnection and records why
A reconnection negotiates again; why it was lost stays visible
A reconnection that negotiates is streaming again
A failed attempt before the transport connected stays in Connecting
A failed first negotiation returns to Connecting
A failed reconnection attempt stays in Reconnecting
A failed renegotiation returns to Reconnecting, not Connecting
No attempt can fail when no session exists
A streaming session does not have attempts; losing it is connection_lost
A session being torn down ignores late attempt results
A failed session ignores late attempt results
A terminal fault is not a failed attempt; it must be reported as failed
The same while negotiating: rejected, state untouched
Retry after a failed attempt; the last failure stays visible until one succeeds
A retry that succeeds clears the recorded failure
Attempts may fail repeatedly; how many is the coordinator's business
A reconnection that succeeds after a failed attempt
After a failed negotiation the transport must connect again first
Stop while connecting
Stop while negotiating
Stop while streaming
Stop while reconnecting
Stop between retries
Teardown completing ends the session
A second stop request changes nothing
No start until teardown has completed
A session being torn down cannot fail
There is nothing to stop
A transport that connects late is ignored
Duplicate start while connecting
Duplicate start while streaming
The transport cannot connect twice
Negotiation cannot complete twice
Negotiation cannot complete before the transport connected
Only a streaming connection can be lost
A loss while negotiating is a failed attempt, not connection_lost
Nothing can connect when no session exists
A lost connection cannot be lost again
A loss with a terminal fault is not a loss to recover from; it must be reported as failed
Failure while connecting
Failure while negotiating
Failure while streaming
Failure while reconnecting, as when the budget is spent
No start until the failure is acknowledged
Acknowledging a failure returns to Disconnected
A failed session has nothing left to stop
The first failure is the one that is kept
There is no failure to acknowledge
There is no teardown to complete
Acknowledge applies only to a failure
A new session can start after a failure is acknowledged
A new session does not inherit that the last one streamed
So its first failed attempt returns to Connecting, not Reconnecting
A new session does not inherit the last one's attempt failure
